# Cool boxes and van runs

> the samples of several requests packed together for one lane, and the van that takes them

**Types:** `CoolBox`, `BoxSlot`, `VanRun`, `BoxRow` (package Cool boxes)

**Commands in:** Add, Arrive, Book, BookTo, Open, Pack

**Events out:** CoolBoxArrived, CoolBoxBooked, VanRunArrived, VanRunBooked

**Policies reacting:** book_boxes (on VanRunBooked); boxes_arrive (on VanRunArrived)

[All topics](index.md)

## Rules

<a id="R18"></a>
### R18 — The samples of several requests going the same way travel in one cool box

`agreed` · definitional · decided in session 4, 2026-03-23

A cool box is packed at a clinic for one lane — from that clinic to one lab — with the samples of any requests going that way, a slot per sample. It is an aggregate of its own: packed before any van is known.

- **Model:** `package Cool boxes`, `CoolBox`, `BoxSlot`
- **Shown by:** 12-two-requests-in-one-cool-box-on-a-van-run

<a id="R19"></a>
### R19 — A van run is booked to its boxes later; its arrival is theirs

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 4, 2026-03-23

The box exists first; booking a van run to it tells the box its van. When the van run arrives, so has every box booked onto it.

- **Model:** `package Cool boxes`, `CoolBox`, `CoolBox.packing on BookTo`, `VanRun`, `book_boxes`
- **Shown by:** 12-two-requests-in-one-cool-box-on-a-van-run

<a id="R20"></a>
### R20 — The vans, seen as a second view of the same run

`agreed` · definitional · decided in session 4, 2026-03-23

Beside the requests, the logistics desk sees the vans: each van run with its boxes under it, a box not booked yet on its own, and in each box its samples, each named with its request — none of the requests' steps (ADR 0034).

- **Untraced:** the overview's configuration, which carries no why:
